prompt.garment: a small crossbody bag shaped like a 1960s space food ration pouch in crinkled silver foil-effect fabric with a zip top, a little tear-notch detail and a thin orange strap, no text
prompt.pose: upper body wearing the ration pouch bag across the chest over a midnight navy blouson

products.name: Saturn Spinner Ring
products.description: Anillo de plata 925 con un aro que gira alrededor de la banda, como los anillos de Saturno.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver spinner ring with a polished domed band and a thin free-rotating outer ring tilted around it like Saturn's rings
prompt.pose: close-up of a hand wearing the spinner ring on the middle finger, spinning the ring with the thumb

products.name: Orbit Hoop Earring
products.description: Pendiente de aro de plata 925 con un pequeño planeta que orbita a lo largo del aro. Se vende por unidad.

prompt.garment: a single sterling silver hoop earring with a tiny polished silver sphere planet sliding along the hoop
prompt.pose: close-up profile of an ear wearing the orbit hoop earring, platinum hair tucked back

products.name: Capsule Pendant
products.description: Colgante de plata 925 con forma de cápsula de reentrada de los 60, en cadena de bolas.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver pendant shaped like a 1960s re-entry space capsule with an engraved hatch and tiny windows, on a silver ball chain
prompt.pose: close-up of the chest wearing the capsule pendant over a white ribbed tank

products.name: Star Chart Tag
products.description: Placa de identificación de plata 925 con un mapa estelar grabado, en cadena de bolas.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver military-style tag pendant engraved with a star chart of dots and constellation lines, no text, on a silver ball chain
prompt.pose: close-up of the neck wearing the star chart tag over a black crewneck

products.name: Star Link Chain
products.description: Cadena de plata 925 con eslabones en forma de estrella de cuatro puntas.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver chain necklace made of interlocking links shaped like four-point stars, lobster clasp, laid in a loose oval
prompt.pose: close-up of the collarbone wearing the star link chain with an open white shirt

products.name: Meteorite Signet
products.description: Sello de plata 925 con la cara martilleada y oxidada como la superficie de un meteorito.

prompt.garment: a chunky sterling silver signet ring with a hammered, pitted, dark oxidized face like the surface of a meteorite and a polished band
prompt.pose: close-up of a hand wearing the meteorite signet on the index finger, resting on a silver metallic trouser leg

products.name: Comet Ear Cuff
products.description: Ear cuff de plata 925 con forma de cometa cuya estela recorre la oreja. Sin agujero.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver ear cuff shaped like a comet: a small polished sphere with a long tapering trail that curves along the ear
prompt.pose: close-up profile of an ear wearing the comet ear cuff, short bleach blonde hair

products.name: Rocket Pendant
products.description: Colgante de plata 925 con forma de cohete de los 60, en cadena de bolas.

prompt.garment: a sterling silver pendant shaped like a sleek 1960s rocket with three fins and a pointed nose cone, polished with oxidized lines, on a silver ball chain
prompt.pose: close-up of the chest wearing the rocket pendant over a safety orange turtleneck
